name: Tsuma no Haha ~Gouman Onna Shachou to Doukyo no Hibi~
original_name: 妻の母～傲慢女社長と同居の日々～
source:
The Motomiya family is said to be one of the most distinguised families in the area. The 17th head of the family, Motomiya Kinue, although a woman, she's also the president of the Motomiya family's parent company, which is one of the largest corporate groups in the area. 

The story begins when Motomiya Mamoru, who married Motomiya Maki, the only daughter of the cold-hearted and manipulative president Kinue and became the son-in-law of the Motomiya family, was ordered by Kinue to break up with her daughter Maki because she hates his guts with a passion.

Which will lead towards the fall of the prideful female president from a prominent family...

[Translated from the [url=http://syuntada.com/tumahaha/kinue_story.html]Official website[/url]]
translation:
据说本宫家族是该地区最显赫的家族之一。第十七代当家本宫衣卫虽然是女性，但她也是本宫家族母公司的社长，该公司是该地区最大的企业集团之一。

故事开始于本宫守，她与冷酷、善于操纵的总裁木卫的独生女本宫真希结婚，成为本宫家的女婿，但因对他的恨之入骨，被木卫勒令与女儿真希分手。

这将导致骄傲的名门女总统的陨落……

[翻译自[url=http://syuntada.com/tumahaha/kinue_story.html]官网[/url]]
